description:
List every movement of money in and out of your wallet, newest first: money added, refunds, bounty funding, and sends paid from the wallet with the worker, their pay and our fee. A send paid by card never moves the wallet, so it is not listed. Keep going until a page has no `nextCursor`.
Use for: reading what came in and went out of your wallet, and what each send paid from it cost.
Not for: your balance and limits (get_wallet); money held on a hire (list_hires).
Money: US cents.
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: list_wallet_transactions({"limit":2})
Errors: only the common ones; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous page. Leave it out for the first page.

limit.description: Rows wanted. A page can hold fewer, or none; only a page without nextCursor is the end.

name: list_wallet_transactions

amount.description: What moved your balance. Always positive; see direction.

balanceAfter.description: Your balance right after this movement.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

transfer.description: Details of the linked send, when readable. Left out when no send is linked or its details cannot be read. On a send, amount includes pay and serviceFee. On a received payment, amount equals pay.

id.description: The profile id of the person on the other side.

serviceFee.description: Our fee, paid by the sender.

type.description: The kind of movement as stored, for example deposit, send, transfer_received, refund or funding_refund. New kinds can appear.

title: List your wallet transactions
